page.overview:
Who is Augusta Longbottom?

Augusta Longbottom (b. pre-1947) was a pure-blood witch who married into the Longbottom family. She was the mother of famous Auror Frank Longbottom, mother-in-law to Auror Alice Longbottom, and grandmother to Neville Longbottom. Through Neville's marriage, she has a granddaughter-in-law, Hannah Abbott.

Little is known about Augusta's early life except that she may have had at least one sibling. During her school years, she failed her Charms O.W.L., causing her to later label it a "soft option". It's likely that Augusta went to school with Minerva McGonagall and attended under Headmaster Dippet. She also wanted her grandson to take Transfiguration at N.E.W.T. level, possibly meaning that while in school, she did well in that subject.

At some point, Augusta married Mr Longbottom, a wizard. They had at least one child, a son, Frank.

In 1947, Neville's "granddad" (most likely her husband) put a fanged gerbil in a handbag of one of Neville's grandmothers (possibly Augusta) as a prank, causing her to always keep a mousetrap inside it from that point onward.
